comparison.objective: Lay cutting templates on streaky glass aligned with the streaks and along one edge; candidate finishes four threaded inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual orientation, planar layout, and edge alignment versus recessed coaxial tooling, bimanual hammering, force regulation, and fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Templates have the required streak and edge orientation versus four fractured/contained tangs with no insert or shell damage.
comparison.reason: Planar template layout tests orientation and packing, not contact-driven fracture of a retained feature. No spec versions, angular tolerances, spacing, or coverage rubric are supplied.
